rows.grounds: Token given as citrādi (legacy: pictures-etc); used as a class marker for images/pictures and similar forms.
From pratimā with -ādi and genitive plural ending in form; denotes images and related items as objects of worship context.
Compound sense indicating purpose: for the sake of worship (pūjā + artha).
Points to the respective front/place (agra) for each; token kept as given (tattadagrake) indicating placement before each such form.
